pages.text: Place a vault within $(bold)3 blocks$() (3×3×3) of a machine, open the machine's GUI and a $(bold)Storage$() button appears at the top-right.$(br2)Click it to unfold an $(bold)18-slot overlay$() that pages through the whole vault - access stored items without leaving the machine screen.

$(bold)Machines:$() Gene Analyzer, Cultivator, Life Structure Table, Surgery Chamber, Potion Table.$(br)$(bold)Vaults:$() Sample Vault, Organ Vault, Potion Cabinet.$(br2)$(2)Example: put the Organ Vault next to the Surgery Chamber for instant implant organs; the Potion Cabinet next to the Potion Table to store finished potions in one click.$()
